manual_review_warnings.message: Only a post-run empty expense table is retained; without the episode result record, the runner completion gate cannot be verified from post-state alone.
Stored evidence lacks a decisive post-run filesystem check for the target path, so path absence/presence under the evaluator cannot be verified.

The retained evidence does not reliably identify the run's `file_name`, `source_folder`, and `destination_folder`, or does not preserve enough end-of-run filesystem state to check both required path conditions.
The retained evidence does not establish whether the runner's episode-completion gate was satisfied.
Retained evidence does not reveal whether the episode was `done`, so the runner gate cannot be checked.
Retained evidence does not preserve the instance values needed to compute the expected final file state, especially `original_content`.
Retained evidence lacks a trustworthy post-run Markor filesystem snapshot or exact file-content capture, so file absence/presence or exact-content checks cannot be resolved.

Stored evidence does not preserve the concrete original_name/new_name/updated_content values, the run-finished status, or enough post-run Markor filesystem/content evidence to apply the official checks, and no contrary decisive evidence is present.
The retained artifacts do not preserve both the episode completion/composed-result record and a post-run view of `MARKOR_DATA`, so the native claim cannot be verified from stored evidence alone.
The retained artifacts do not provide enough evidence to determine both the suite `done` status and the final state/content of `MARKOR_DATA/{file_name}`.
Retained artifacts do not establish both the final `done` status and the final evaluator-visible contents of `/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor`.
Undecided if retained evidence does not reveal the concrete assigned `file_name`.
Retained evidence lacks either the target note/folder values and done-gate result from the run record, or a reliable post-run view of the relevant Markor source and destination folders.
The retained evidence does not establish the task instance's official `file_name` or expected `text`.

Retained evidence does not preserve enough information to recover the instantiated expected `is_todo` value, the terminal answer text, and the completion/native-score status needed to apply the released evaluator.

The stored evidence does not preserve enough to check both the scored-episode condition and the final submitted answer text, and the remaining artifacts do not already record a decisive native success or failure outcome.
The retained evidence does not include a readable post-run `favorites.gpx` snapshot, so the evaluator-visible waypoint match for the official `location` cannot be checked from stored artifacts.
The retained evidence lacks a readable post-run `map_markers` snapshot or row export, so the released OsmAnd matcher cannot be applied.
Undecided if retained GPX evidence appears matching but there is no retained evidence that the episode terminated, because `_run_task` zeros an otherwise-successful task score when `done` is false.

The released run record is retained but no post-run playlist DB snapshot or equivalent query export is retained, so the reviewer cannot confirm that the stored result aligns with the evaluator-visible playlist state.
The retained evidence includes neither a native episode result nor a playback-state snapshot sufficient to inspect the final `playing_queue`.
The retained evidence does not include a reliable episode result showing both the target playlist name and whether the run reached `interaction_results.done=true`.
The retained evidence does not include a readable Retro Music playlist snapshot or exported row set sufficient to check every returned `playlist_name` and sum `duration_ms`.

Undecided if no retained episode result score is available and the retained artifacts do not provide enough information to recover the requested playlist parameters and determine both evaluator-visible post-run checks.
The retained evidence does not identify the exact {file_name} for this case instance.
There is no retained scored result record for the case, or exception_info is non-null.
There is no trustworthy retained post-run Download listing or snapshot to evaluate the exact-path existence check used by the native evaluator.
Stored evidence omits the run's expected `number` or `message`, or omits either the sent-message snapshot or the scoring-time foreground-activity record needed to apply the released evaluator.
The retained evidence does not preserve a normal final benchmark decision for this case.
The retained evidence cannot establish the evaluator-visible Bluetooth state at post-run evaluation time.
Stored evidence does not establish the suite runner completion status and does not retain the evaluator-visible final `screen_brightness` value.
The native claim is also undecided when only trajectory artifacts are retained and there is neither a final episode result nor equivalent post-run brightness-setting evidence.
The retained artifacts do not establish both the runner done gate and the final evaluator-visible `system screen_brightness` value.
No retained numeric is_successful score is available, and the stored evidence does not show a failing WiFi or Bluetooth check.
Retained score evidence and retained evaluator-visible settings evidence materially conflict.
